_comment: GENERATED by ops/build-registry-sources.mjs from site/src/services.json. Do not edit. These are POINTERS, not claims — the registry fetches each one from the operator's own domain and checks its signature on every request, so an entry here cannot make a bad listing appear. It can only point at something that fails verification and shows up in `dropped`. Being in this list is not a condition of being usable: an agent that knows an endpoint reads its /.well-known/warda-service.json directly, with no registry involved.
